title: Spicy Beef Stew
description: A hearty beef stew with a kick of spice, perfect for a cold winter's night. This recipe serves 4-6 people and can be made in under an hour.
instructions: Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add 1 tablespoon oil and sear the beef until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the onion, red pepper, and sweet pepper to the pot and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, chili powder, and cumin to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef broth to the pot and bring to a boil.
Return the beef to the pot and reduce heat to low.
Simmer the stew for 30-40 minutes, or until the beef is tender.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
